Assumptions (made explicit, each has a test):
• Input is a string containing zero or more duration components, each consisting of a positive integer followed by a unit
• Units are case-sensitive: only lowercase 's', 'm', 'h', 'd' are recognized.
• Components may appear in any order, and the same unit may appear multiple times; all components are summed.
• The input may be an empty string, which returns 0.
• No spaces or other characters are allowed; only digits and the letters s, m, h, d.
• The return type is an integer total number of seconds.
• The function does not need to handle invalid input (e.g., missing unit, negative numbers, uppercase letters, non-string
input); behavior for such inputs is unspecified.
